title: The CEO of Patreon blasts AI companies for the ‘bogus excuse’ they’re using to not pay artists | Fortune
summary: Patreon's CEO criticizes AI companies for using creators' work without permission and for allegedly exploiting a 'fair use' loophole, while striking significant deals with major corporations.
sentiment_reason: The article presents a strong negative sentiment due to the criticism of AI companies' practices and the perceived unfair treatment of smaller creators.
